question: Which theory suggests that planets were formed out of a cloud of material surrounding a young Sun?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Nebular Hypothesis**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Nebular Hypothesis was first proposed by **Immanuel Kant** in 1755 and further developed by **Pierre-Simon Laplace** in 1796.
 
• This theory suggests that planets formed from a **rotating cloud of gas and dust**, called a solar nebula, around the young Sun.
 
• Gravity caused the nebula to collapse and spin faster, forming a central protostar (the Sun) and a surrounding disk where planets formed.
 
• It explains the **flat, disk-like structure** of the solar system and the uniform direction of planetary orbits.
 
• Modern evidence supporting the Nebular Hypothesis includes **observations of protoplanetary disks** around young stars.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Solar Nebula:**

 
 
• The solar nebula is a vast rotating cloud of gas and dust from which the Sun and planets formed.
 
• It primarily consisted of hydrogen, helium, and trace elements, which later condensed into planetary bodies.
 
 
 
• **Protoplanetary Disk:**
 
 
• This is the flat, rotating disk of material surrounding a protostar where planets and other celestial bodies form.
 
• Such disks are often observed around young stars, supporting the Nebular Hypothesis.
 
 
 
• **Accretion:**
 
 
• Accretion refers to the process by which particles in the protoplanetary disk collide and stick together, forming larger bodies like planets.
 
• Over time, gravity pulls these bodies together to form fully-fledged planets.
 
 
 
• **Modern Observations:**
 
 
• Telescopes like the Hubble Space Telescope have captured images of protoplanetary disks around young stars.
 
• These observations provide direct evidence of the processes described by the Nebular Hypothesis.
